title: Calendar assertion ages past its fixed year
root_cause: The failed run and the successful baseline use the same commit. The test compares the current UTC year to a fixed value of 2025, so it passes in 2025 and fails after the calendar turns to 2026. No change in the compared range caused the failure.

relevant_evidence.why: The calendar test reports the current year and its fixed expectation.
The test reads the current time and expects a fixed year.
